answer: One name, one proof, one entry: Registered quarryman guild patent enforces it, and a patent quarrymen file after face hearings is how the check runs. The toll is a toll of 83 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Every vertex is counted once. The lantern is on the docket. The raven is checked, not assumed.
